pedal: Boss RT-2 Rotary Ensemble (mono in: INPUT A; stereo out: OUTPUT A and B), each rotor alone, clean
note: Effect on, LED green (hold the RT-2's own pedal if it's red), Slow (outer ring of knob 2) to 9:00. Set the outer ring of knob 1 twice: Drive Knob toggle to DRIVE, ring to 7:00 (no Drive); then toggle to BALANCE, ring to 12:00. Leave the toggle on BALANCE for the whole run: from here on the ring sets Balance only. Give the rotors ~10 s.

rig.note: Boss RT-2 on its 9 V adapter, each rotor alone again (clean: plans/rt-2-isolated.json). Input from interface out 3; OUTPUT A -> input 2, OUTPUT B -> input 1; INST, AIR off, pad on, gain fully counter-clockwise.
